findings.claim: The deployed-route and Lighthouse quality gates run only after the artifact has already been published, so their failure cannot prevent a defective site from shipping.
findings.evidence: The deploy job runs before certify-deployment and the build job omits Lighthouse.
findings.suggested_fix: Run Lighthouse against the built artifact before upload while retaining deployed-origin probes.

findings.claim: The change records no target-specific verification evidence or unresolved deployment limits despite an explicit acceptance criterion requiring both before archive.
findings.evidence: No target-specific verification report records executed gates, pending public deployment, and release impact.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a target-specific final verification receipt with local results and public/manual limits.

findings.claim: A request for an existing directory without an index.html is treated as a successful file lookup and can terminate the local test server with an unhandled read-stream error.
findings.evidence: findFile returns a joined index path without statting it and the stream has no error listener.
findings.suggested_fix: Verify the directory index and handle stream failures.
